user_text: Our analytical chemistry laboratory currently loads sample vials into a heated mixing chamber by hand, one at a time. The manual loading limits throughput to roughly thirty samples per day, introduces timing variability between mixing starts, and occasionally skips a vial entirely during long unattended overnight runs. We need a benchtop device that automatically sequences twelve sample vials into the heated mixing chamber at controlled intervals, keeps the chamber temperature stable while the tray advances, and records which vial entered at which time so the overnight batch can be audited afterwards. The device must fit on a standard laboratory bench, run from a single mains outlet, and be cleanable with standard laboratory solvents.
